name: duopore-public-open-day-question-pack
description: Make a useful list of questions for a course visit or school open day.
keywords: know what to ask a school

interface.shortDescription: Know what to ask a school
interface.longDescription: Make a useful list of questions for a course visit or school open day. Share what you already know, the facts still missing and what matters most to you. Get questions in your priority order, with known answers kept beside them. For adults researching their own study choices. The app does not fetch answers or assess your chance of admission.
capabilities: Know what to ask a school
defaultPrompt: Make questions for my course open day from these missing facts.
Help me ask about the course details I still need to check.

positive.prompt: Use Open-day Question Pack with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs.
